note: Skill tree data. A skill's ref points into content/calisthenics/<file> '### <rung>.' so the full progression text lives there once. Criteria are coaching conventions (see content/calisthenics/README.md), not physiological thresholds.

skills.name: Wrist prep
skills.how: Kneel, palms down, fingers forward then sideways then back; rock gently over the hands, then wrist circles. Pain-free, no forcing.

criterion.note: 2 rounds of 60 s of rocks and circles, pain-free

skills.name: Overhead shoulder reach
skills.how: Back to the wall, ribs down, glutes and head touching it; slide the arms overhead keeping the lower back flat and the forearms on the wall.

criterion.note: arms fully overhead without the ribs flaring or the lower back arching

skills.name: Deep squat hold
skills.how: Sink into a full-depth squat with heels down and chest up; hold, using a doorframe for balance if needed.

skills.name: Seated forward fold
skills.how: Sit with straight legs and fold from the hips, reaching toward the toes without rounding hard; breathe and relax.

criterion.note: hands reach the toes or beyond without bending the knees

skills.name: Wall plank
skills.how: Hands on the floor, feet on the wall at hip height, body straight from head to heels with arms locked and shoulders pushed tall.

skills.name: Handstand bail (safe exit)
skills.how: On a clear floor practise coming down out of a kick-up: step out, or cartwheel out, with control, before holding anything.

skills.name: Wall handstand hold
skills.how: Chest-to-wall: walk the feet up the wall as the hands walk in; arms locked, shoulders elevated, body tight. Exit under control.

skills.name: Pike push-up
skills.how: From a push-up start walk the feet in and lift the hips into an inverted V; lower the head to a tripod point just ahead of the hands and press.

skills.name: Elevated pike push-up
skills.how: Feet on a chair or box (braced), hips stacked over the shoulders as far as you can, then pike push-ups.

skills.name: Deficit pike push-up on handles
skills.how: Elevated pike with hands on push-up handles so the head can drop below hand level for extra range.

skills.name: Wall handstand push-up negative
skills.how: From the wall handstand lower slowly (3-5 s) until the head touches a folded cushion, then come down off the wall and reset.

skills.name: Partial-range wall handstand push-up
skills.how: Lower to a stack of cushions, pause, press back to lockout. Lower the stack over weeks.

criterion.note: to a given height; then lower the stack

skills.name: Wall handstand push-up (full)
skills.how: Full range to the floor or a thin mat, with a controlled lowering and a press to lockout, facing the wall.

criterion.note: our benchmark, the content sets no number; strict and controlled

skills.name: Deficit wall handstand push-up on handles
skills.how: Full wall handstand push-up with the hands on push-up handles so the head travels below hand level.

criterion.note: our benchmark; stable handles, mat under the head

skills.caveat: Handles must be rock solid and non-rolling; a fall from here is onto the head. Use a mat.

skills.name: Handstand heel pulls
skills.how: Kick up to the wall, then gently pull one heel then both away from it, catching balance with finger pressure; return to the wall.

criterion.note: 3 sets of heels off the wall for about 5 s

skills.name: Freestanding handstand
skills.how: Kick up on a clear floor with a bail ready; balance with finger pressure, body stacked straight.

criterion.note: 3 holds of about 10 s, no wall contact

skills.name: Freestanding handstand push-up
skills.how: From a freestanding handstand lower under control and press back, keeping balance throughout.

skills.name: Incline push-up
skills.how: Hands on a stable raised surface (table, counter, sturdy bench), body straight; lower the chest to the edge and press.

skills.name: Push-up
skills.how: Plank with elbows about 45 degrees; lower the chest to a fist above the floor, press up. On push-up handles the wrists stay neutral, but the floor works too.

skills.name: Deep (deficit) push-up on handles
skills.how: Push-up with the hands on handles so the chest sinks below hand level; control the bottom, no bouncing.

skills.name: Archer push-up on handles
skills.how: Wide stance, lower toward one hand while the other arm stays long, then press back and alternate.

skills.name: Pseudo-planche push-up on handles
skills.how: Hands by the hips pointing back or out, lean the shoulders well past the hands and push-up while keeping the lean.

skills.name: One-arm push-up progression
skills.how: Incline one-arm push-ups, then one-arm negatives, then full reps; feet wide, hips square.

criterion.note: on the incline, before lowering the height

skills.name: Planche lean
skills.how: Straight-arm plank on handles, lean the shoulders forward over and past the hands, toes light, hollow body. Short, quality holds.

criterion.note: a clear lean with protracted shoulders

skills.caveat: Straight-arm work loads elbows and wrists; two or three sessions a week at most.

skills.name: Crow pose on handles
skills.how: Squat on the handles, knees on the upper arms, lean forward until the feet lift; gaze ahead, hands pressing the floor.

skills.name: Tuck planche on handles
skills.how: From the lean lift the feet with knees tucked, back rounded slightly, arms straight; hold.

skills.name: Advanced tuck planche
skills.how: Tuck planche with the back flat and hips opened to about 90 degrees; long-term goal.

criterion.note: our benchmark; the content gives no number

skills.name: Support hold
skills.how: Straight arms on the bars or handles, shoulders pressed down away from the ears, elbows locked, body still.

skills.name: Negative dip
skills.how: From support, lower slowly (5 s) to the target depth, then step down.

skills.name: Feet-assisted dip
skills.how: Dip with light foot pressure on a chair or box under or behind you.

skills.name: Dip
skills.how: Strict full-range dip on parallel bars, controlled down and a full lockout.

skills.name: Dip on handles
skills.how: Strict dip between two tall, stable handles or parallettes, body clearing the floor.

criterion.note: our benchmark; the content does not rate handle dips

skills.caveat: Only if the handles are tall enough for your body to clear the floor at the bottom and are completely stable; otherwise use dip bars.

skills.name: Tuck L-sit
skills.how: Support hold with knees pulled to the chest and feet off the floor; shoulders pushed down, back round.

skills.name: One-leg L-sit
skills.how: One leg straight forward, the other tucked; hold and switch.

skills.name: L-sit
skills.how: Both legs straight and horizontal in front, arms locked, shoulders depressed.

skills.name: Plank
skills.how: Forearms or hands on the floor, glutes tight, ribs down, straight line from head to heels.

skills.name: Hollow body hold
skills.how: On your back, lower back glued to the floor, arms overhead and legs low, shoulders lifted; hold the shape.

skills.name: Hanging knee raise
skills.how: Dead hang, raise the knees to the chest with no swing.

skills.name: Hanging leg raise
skills.how: Straight or slightly bent legs up to at least horizontal, hips square.

skills.name: Toes to bar
skills.how: Strict leg raise all the way to the bar, controlled lowering.

criterion.note: strict, needs clearance for the legs

skills.name: Windshield wiper
skills.how: Toes at the bar, rotate the legs side to side keeping them high.

skills.name: Bodyweight squat
skills.how: Feet shoulder width, full depth, knees tracking the toes, chest up.

skills.name: Split squat
skills.how: Long stance, lower the back knee toward the floor, front shin near vertical.

skills.name: Bulgarian split squat
skills.how: Rear foot on a chair or step; lower under control on the front leg.

skills.name: Shrimp squat
skills.how: Hold the rear foot, lower the rear knee to the floor on one leg and stand.

skills.name: Pistol squat
skills.how: Single-leg squat to full depth with the other leg straight in front.

skills.name: Glute bridge
skills.how: On the back, feet flat, drive hips up and squeeze the glutes at the top.

skills.name: Single-leg glute bridge
skills.how: Bridge with one foot on the floor, hips level.

skills.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
skills.how: Hinge on one leg with a flat back, the other leg trailing, no balance support.

skills.name: Nordic curl (eccentric)
skills.how: Kneel with the feet anchored, lower the torso forward under control as far as you can.

criterion.note: controlled lowering most of the way

skills.caveat: Needs the feet anchored securely under something heavy or held by a partner.

skills.name: Dead hang
skills.how: Hang from a bar with a firm grip, shoulders engaged, relaxed legs.

criterion.note: including 10 s in an active hang

skills.name: Scapular pull-up
skills.how: From a dead hang depress and retract the shoulder blades to lift the body a few centimetres, arms straight.

skills.name: Negative pull-up
skills.how: Jump or step to the top, lower yourself slowly over about 5 s.

skills.name: Feet-assisted pull-up
skills.how: Pull up with light foot pressure on a chair or box.

skills.name: Pull-up
skills.how: Dead hang to chin over the bar, controlled lowering to full extension.

skills.name: Chin-up
skills.how: Underhand grip, chin over the bar, controlled lowering.

skills.name: L-sit pull-up
skills.how: Pull-up with the legs held at or near horizontal.

skills.name: Archer pull-up
skills.how: Pull toward one hand while the other arm stays long, then alternate.

skills.name: Typewriter pull-up
skills.how: At the top, shift side to side keeping the chin above the bar.

criterion.note: side to side and back is 1

skills.name: One-arm pull-up progression
skills.how: One-arm negatives of 5 s each side, then assisted reps.

skills.name: Chest-to-bar pull-up
skills.how: A strict pull-up pulled higher until the lower chest touches the bar.

skills.name: Muscle-up
skills.how: Strict pull to the bar, transition over it and press out to support.
skills.caveat: Needs a bar with room above it; doorway bars often do not allow it.

skills.name: Steep incline row
skills.how: Hold a low bar, body at a steep angle, row the chest to the bar.
skills.caveat: Bar must be low and set securely (dip bar or low pull-up bar).

skills.name: Inverted row, knees bent
skills.how: Hip-height bar, knees bent, row the chest to the bar.

skills.name: Inverted row, legs straight
skills.how: Body straight, heels on the floor, row with a 1 s squeeze at the top.

skills.name: Feet-elevated inverted row
skills.how: Feet on a chair or box, row to the bar.

skills.name: Archer row
skills.how: Row to one hand while the other arm extends; hip-height bar.

skills.name: Skin the cat
skills.how: From a hang tuck the knees and rotate backward through the arms, then reverse slowly.
skills.caveat: Have a practised bail; check the room above and below the bar.

skills.name: Tuck back lever
skills.how: From skin-the-cat hold a tucked horizontal position behind the bar, arms straight.

skills.name: Tuck front lever
skills.how: Hang, lift the knees tucked until the back is flat and horizontal, arms straight.
